title: Mixtures
info: A mixture combines things that are not chemically joined. A salad is a mixture.
A solution is a mixture where something dissolves, like salt stirred into water.

questions.q: Salt that disappears into water has

options: a mixture where one thing dissolves in another
two solids glued by a new chemical always
pure water with nothing in it

questions.q: You can often pick the peas out of fried rice because
options: a mixture's parts can stay themselves

Type the mixture where something dissolves, such as salt in water.
